title: Mixed Event — Wonderhorror?! A Test of Courage! — Episode7 A Happy Smiley Test of Courage

meta.Episode: Episode7 — A Happy Smiley Test of Courage
meta.Event Outline: Class representatives Emu and Mafuyu are assigned to run a voluntary weeding activity. But no one's signing up to pull weeds in the blazing summer heat! Emu thinks of a way to make it fun for the participants.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... Just gotta mark where to jump out and... All set!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm done over here♪
How are you guys doing, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We've finished setting up as well.
So, that just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... Sorry for the wait!
This customer asked me to help with their outfit near the end of my shift, and I really had my work cut out for me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's okay.
We haven't begun the test of courage yet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Exactly!
So, let's have go out there and have fun scaring everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I promise to be a really good scarer in return for being late!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, now that we're all here, let's quickly review the plan.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Starting with our roles.
I'll be guiding everyone to the finish line, while the rest of you will be scarers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Each group will consist of three people.
Whenever I reach a scare point, I'll give the signal for you to jump out—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And that's when we jump out and scare the pants off them!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's it for me...
Is there anything you'd like to add, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anything I'd like to add...?
Oh, that reminds me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't want just the participants of our test of courage to have fun. I want everyone to, including the guide and the scarers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all enjoy ourselves and make sure we all go home smiling!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's very dark, so please watch your step as you go along.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: I-It's a lot darker than I thought...!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student C
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
And that tree... I bet something's gonna jump out at us from behind it!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: Still, it's really nice to have Asahina guiding us through...!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Even if a ghost were to pop out, we should be fine!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Are you sure about that?
What if I dashed ahead and left you all behind?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Oh, wait. Did you hear that?

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student C
rows.Line:
Huh? Hear what...?
Don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: Huh? Something's coming at us from behind...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Huh?!
I-It's a big monster... No, wait!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Check it out! It's a big dog plushie!
It's so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: This isn't scary at all. I guess we got all worked up over nothing.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: If anything, this is sorta heartwarming.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. But this dog isn't alone.
Quite a few other ghosts haunt this place, so you'll have to keep your eyes peeled.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
...!
Hey, I'm hearing more weird noises.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student C
rows.Line: M-Me too... And it sounds like they're getting closer.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Huh...? Wh-What?
It's hopping around so much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Looks like you're here to test your courage meow♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There are lots of fun and scary things up ahead meow! But it's really dark, so be careful meow♪

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: Oh! It's so cute and helpful!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Looks like you're welcome here.
Thank you, Ms. Monster.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
That monster was so nice...!
I kinda wish we could've stayed to talk to her more!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Me too! Huh...?
Is it just me, or is it starting to get colder?

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It was really warm a second ago. Wait, does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes.
Legend has it that she appears here.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line: Th-This is my first time seeing her up close! I only saw her from afar a couple of times while pulling weeds...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student C
rows.Line:
A-And she's dressed as a yuki-onna!
How often does this happen?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As a yuki-onna, I have the power to make it snow♪ Isn't it perfect for a hot summer day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're welcome to rest and cool down here.
But please watch your step when you resume your adventure.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You did such a wonderful job that you seemed just like the real thing...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that I was able to borrow that snow maker from Kamishiro♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: On top of being really cute, you gave them a chance to cool down while they tested their courage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, let's keep up the good work, and scare lots and lots more people!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schoolers
rows.Line: That was a really fun test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schoolers
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's wasn't scary at all! Let's go again!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All the participants have safely descended the mountain and gone home. Oh, one group is still using the restroom. Once we see them off, that'll be everyone.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Ah, welcome back.
Thank you for being such wonderful monsters and spirits.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, he was a part of the final group...
Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
I... I had a lot of fun today!
I promise to come back again soon!

rows.Speaker: Boy's Father
rows.Line:
Kenta!
If you're done using the bathroom, we're going home!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Okay!
Anyway, thanks again for today!

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
He wants to come back.
I don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Even while we pulled weeds, I heard quite a few people say many kind things.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
And I have all of you to thank.
Your efforts have not gone unnoticed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm so glad we got everyone to smile!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway!
Now that everyone's gone, let's start cleaning up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
It's very dark, so we'll need to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, sir... Would you mind lending us the key to the storeroom? We'd like to put back everything we borrowed.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Let me just... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I can't seem to find the key to the storeroom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Would you like us to help you look?
If you can tell us about where you think you dropped it...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Yes, so...
I definitely had it on me after we finished pulling weeds. I remember going to and from the storeroom a few times.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Then, I walked the course for your test of courage to make sure everything was ready. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: I may have dropped it somewhere along that path.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Along the course...?
That may make finding it a bit difficult.

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
I know...
But you've all been working since morning. I couldn't possibly ask you to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We might find it while we're cleaning everything up, so I'll be more than happy to look for it...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I've still got plenty of stamina left!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I think we've reached a consensus.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The course itself is very long, so let's divide it up into two halves. Sir, if you, Hinomori and Mizuki can search the area from the start line until the midpoint...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Otori, Mochizuki and I will search the latter half.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. It's part two of our test of courage! Let's do our best, you guys!
